gloss: to be overwhelmed; to be overpowered

definitions.gloss: to be overwhelmed; to be overpowered; to be awed
definitions.explanation: To feel completely dominated or overcome by something far greater in power, scale, or intensity. Can describe being impressed to the point of speechlessness, or being defeated by a stronger force.

notes:
USAGE:
{圧倒|あっとう}される is the passive form of ⟦{圧倒|あっとう}する→圧倒する：17122_attousuru⟧. It is far more commonly used than the active form in everyday speech. The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks what overwhelms the speaker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed by the intensity)
- ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed by sheer numbers)
- {圧倒|あっとう}される⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (an overwhelming feeling)
- {圧倒|あっとう}されて⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to be speechless with awe)
